method: Unchanged original classes on the DifficultyProbe/EquipmentProbe world double (Difficulty Normal) with a real EntityPlayer (the DifficultyProbe construction). melee: EntityMob.attackEntityAsMob of a zombie (bare hand, sword, Knockback I and II) then a second hit inside the hurt window; offsets are attacker minus player in blocks, motion0 the player motion before, yaw the zombie rotationYaw in degrees. golem: EntityIronGolem.attackEntityAsMob. arrow: EntityArrow.onUpdate flying into the player (Punch 0-2, with and without a shooter entity). blast: Explosion.doExplosionA at the offset with a living exploder and with none. attrs: generic.movementSpeed and generic.attackDamage of the player under the potion effects. The player has 1000 health so that no hit kills (EntityPlayer.onDeath replaces the motion with the death throw, which Survival does not model). Coincident attackers draw Math.random and are not recorded.
